theorems.name: Submission.lpf_pushforward_is_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ContinuousOn f U → (∀ K, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ T.support)) → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ M ∩ K, ‖L x‖ ≤ C) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn V n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) n) (f x)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
